name: AddressZen
description: AddressZen helps businesses verify, standardize and autocomplete postal addresses, and validate emails and phone numbers.

events.d: Retrieve a full address record for a chosen suggestion ID; optional filter, licensee, and tags can be set.
Check whether an email address is deliverable, disposable, role-based or free.
Verify and standardize a US address against USPS data, with ZIP+4 and delivery details.
Search addresses by partial text and get ranked suggestions with IDs for a chosen country.
Validate a phone number and get its country, formats and carrier details.
